title: How to Ride to Cave Point
why: Renters want the actual route before they commit. Saves and shares.
hook_options: How to ride from our shop to Cave Point.
Three lefts and you're at the cliffs.
The Cave Point route, turn by turn.
caption: The route we'd ride from our Jacksonport shop to Cave Point: Hwy 57, left on Lake Shore Road, left on Cave Point Drive, left on Schauer Road. About 4 miles, mostly quiet country roads, and the motor does the hills. Save this before your ride. #CavePoint #DoorCounty #Jacksonport #EBikeRental

slides.headline: How to ride from our shop to Cave Point.
slides.body: About 4 miles, mostly quiet country roads. The turns, what to watch for and what to do when you get there.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Website Ebike Photos/Cave-Point-Fat-Tire-E-Bike-Rentals.jpg

slides.headline: Start on Hwy 57 in Jacksonport.
slides.body: Our shop is at 6329 State Hwy 57. You're only on the highway for about half a mile.

slides.headline: Left on Lake Shore Road.
slides.body: Just under a mile. Traffic thins out fast once you're off the highway.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/IMG_0656.JPG

slides.headline: Left on Cave Point Drive.
slides.body: About a mile through the woods. Ride single file and stay to the right.

slides.headline: Left on Schauer Road to the park.
slides.body: About a mile and a half more to Cave Point County Park. Park the bike and walk out to the ledge.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/May_26th_11am_Tour.JPG

slides.headline: Country roads. Cars still use them.
slides.body: Ride single file, stay right, and signal before every turn. Lights on if it's gray out.

slides.headline: Wet rock is slick rock.
slides.body: The ledges get slippery when wet or icy, and weather turns fast. Keep a step back from the edge.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Door County Kayak Tours/Assets/DCKT/DCKT Photos/EBike Photos/Cave Point ebike/IMG_0610.JPG

slides.headline: Watch the safety video first.
slides.body: It's on the rental page and covers the controls. A few minutes, and you ride out confident.

slides.headline: 57, Lake Shore, Cave Point Drive, Schauer.
slides.body: Three lefts after the highway. About 4 miles. The motor handles the hills.

slides.headline: Screenshot it. Go ride it.
slides.body: Book an e-bike at doorcountykayaktours.com. Send this to whoever's navigating.
